name: Appointments
description: Book, reschedule and cancel clinic appointments and see how busy each day is
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read the clinic schedule; require auth for every appointment endpoint, and each signed-in user sees and changes only the appointments they booked; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

Appointment validation: patient_name is a required non-empty string of at most 100 characters, date a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), time a 24-hour time (HH:MM), reason an optional string of at most 500 characters; new appointments start with status scheduled

GET /api/appointments lists the signed-in user's active appointments by date and time, earliest first; ?status= filters by status, ?start_date= and ?end_date= keep appointments on or between those dates (inclusive), ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching appointment

PATCH /api/appointments/:id changes any of patient_name, date, time, reason and status (scheduled, completed or cancelled); cancelling is a PATCH to status cancelled, and a cancelled appointment cannot be changed again (409)
Several appointments may share the same date and time (the clinic has several rooms); there is no per-slot limit

GET /api/schedule shows how busy a day is: for ?date= (default today) it lists each time that has scheduled appointments with the number booked, earliest first; cancelled and inactive appointments are not counted
Deactivated appointments (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/appointments and GET /api/schedule and answer 404 on GET /api/appointments/:id; the admin overview still lists them

Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 for changing a cancelled appointment
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the clinic schedule: a date picker and the booked times of that day with how many appointments each has; signed-in users also get their own appointments and the booking controls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to book appointments' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
My appointments: a list with date, time, patient name, reason and a status badge, filters for status and a date range, and previous/next paging
A booking form (patient name, date, time, optional reason) and a reschedule form for an existing appointment, both showing the API's validation messages next to the form

Each scheduled appointment offers 'Mark completed' and 'Cancel' (cancel asks for confirmation); cancelled appointments are shown greyed out without edit controls, and a delete control removes an appointment after confirmation
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every appointment of every user, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts and a count per status
Toggle an appointment's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: The signed-in user's active appointments, earliest first, filtered and paged

query.status: Only appointments with this status (scheduled, completed or cancelled)
query.start_date: Only appointments on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
query.end_date: Only appointments on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

api_endpoints.description: Book an appointment for the signed-in user
One of the signed-in user's appointments
Change some fields of an appointment (every field optional; status cancelled cancels it)
Booked times of one day with the number of scheduled appointments at each, no patient details

query.date: The day to show (YYYY-MM-DD, default today)

data_models.name: Appointment
data_models.description: One booked visit, owned by the user who booked it

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who booked it)
fields.status: string (one of: scheduled, completed, cancelled; default scheduled)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the appointment from its owner and the schedule)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every appointment with counts
